description: Synthetic failure scenarios for the reliable AI exploration worker. Public acceptance invariants, not a solution or mandatory API. Inject faults locally; never contact off-origin destinations.

scenarios.name: Two tenants, same run identifier
scenarios.setup: Create tenant-alpha/run-01 and tenant-beta/run-01 with separate browser contexts and interleave their work.
scenarios.fault: Both generate a finding with the same local identifier.
expectedInvariants: Reports and artifacts remain isolated by tenant and run.
One run cannot consume or overwrite the other run budget or evidence.
Tenant/run identifiers cannot escape the configured output root.

scenarios.name: Crash and restart
scenarios.setup: Consume at least one model call and commit at least one finding.
scenarios.fault: Terminate execution and restart the same logical run.
expectedInvariants: Previously consumed action/model budgets remain consumed.
Committed findings are preserved and not duplicated.
The resumed report states that recovery occurred and any limitation.

scenarios.name: Effect occurred, acknowledgment lost
scenarios.setup: The executor may perform a cart update.
scenarios.fault: Inject interruption after dispatch and before persistence of the outcome.
expectedInvariants: The uncertain outcome is recorded honestly.
The interaction is not blindly replayed as if it had certainly failed.
Recovery re-observes or pauses for human guidance, with a documented reason.

scenarios.name: Model output is unusable or unsafe
scenarios.setup: Use scripted responses for deterministic runs.
scenarios.fault: Return malformed output, then an off-origin action proposal in separate test cases.
expectedInvariants: Invalid/forbidden proposals do not reach browser execution.
Retries are bounded and accounted for.
The report distinguishes validation/policy failure from a target application bug.

scenarios.name: Cancellation with work pending
scenarios.setup: Hold one browser or model operation in flight.
scenarios.fault: Request stop before that operation completes.
expectedInvariants: No subsequent action is dispatched after the stop is accepted.
Partial results and a stop reason are saved.
Any late result is handled according to an explicit policy without resuming exploration.

scenarios.name: Confident false finding
scenarios.setup: The local target exposes a working image and known observed state.
scenarios.fault: The scripted model claims the working image is broken without matching browser evidence.
expectedInvariants: The claim is not marked as a confirmed defect.
The report preserves uncertainty or explains rejection.
The evaluation records expected versus actual behavior.
